reviews.comment: Dr. Horn is probably the best professor I've taken at TAMU. She's kind and understanding of deadlines in other classes, so she is willing to push assignments back. Her lectures, although not the most exciting, are incredibly informative and connect what you learn to the real world. Overall, take her at all costs, even if she only has an 8am :)

Staci is carrying the BMEN department on her shoulders. She is so relatable and knows that we have other responsibilities outside of her class, which is so kind of her. Her lectures and notes are always posted on Canvas, which is super helpful, and she always answers questions very well. Please treasure her!! She deserves the whole world.

I love Staci!!! She is the absolute best and cares about us so, so much. She doesn't want her class to be too hard because she knows we have lives and other classes, and that is so rare to find in the BMEN department. Please respect her with all of your soul because she deserves it. The class is not bad, with HW she works through and easy projects.

In my opinion, this class was the hardest for me, but most found it easier. I thought the material was very difficult and the exams were just as difficult, all short answers. Also, know conceptual topics not just math. This was essentially another Calc 4 class. Prof Horn is amazing though and does everything she can to help.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Jessen is very caring, always willing to make time for one-on-one office hours, and understands that the class material is difficult. My only complaints are that she would promise to post material onto canvas and wouldn't, and she sometimes did not know the answers to our questions about the material. Take Jessen over other professors for 211.

This is an ECEN + MATH class combined. Considering how difficult the topics are, Dr. Jessen does a fantastic job at working through the problems with you. She is very soft-spoken and aware of testing anxiety, so she does her BEST to alleviate any pressure. Loved this prof and everything she does for her students.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall Dr. Jessen taught a fairly difficult class in a very clear and concise way. She posted lectures online with a format where she wrote notes down with a camera pointed at her paper, which was probably the best way to teach this subject in my opinion. Grades came from equally weighted exams and from homework, which was not graded for accuracy.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures
